system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: When an agent wakes up it gets: knowledge of CAR, a pre-defined `contextspace`, the current ticket, and optionally the previous agent's output.
system_prompt_style.note: Inferred from README prose only; no prompt-assembly code in bundle. The repository evidence (Lancetwang/car, ACL paper CAR) is a different system and was not used for any cell.

env_context_strategy.note: Only README/docs of codex-autorunner available. README mentions a 'contextspace' injected to agents, but navigation is delegated to wrapped agents (Codex/Hermes/OpenCode). No source code for this was available.

context_compaction.note: No source code or config schema for codex-autorunner in bundle.

observation_format.note: Observations are handled by wrapped agents; no conversion code in bundle.

tool_call_format.note: Meta-harness; tool-call syntax belongs to wrapped agents; no parser in bundle.

tool_count.note: No tool registry for codex-autorunner in bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by wrapped agents; no edit tool in bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: The protocol is ACP (Agent Client Protocol). MCP could not be checked because the source was not available, so it is not coded as absent.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: At its core, CAR is a state machine: while there are incomplete tickets, pick the next one and run it against an agent.
loop_primitives.note: The plan becomes tickets that are executed from a queue. This could also be read as fixed_pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Convert it into CAR tickets (markdown + frontmatter)
planning_granularity.note: Tickets are files that the state machine reads across runs.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: while there are incomplete tickets, pick the next one and run it against an agent
multi_agent_topology.note: One agent per ticket, run in sequence. Review coordinators that spawn subagents are reachable through configuration (docs/adding-an-agent.md).

delegation_mechanism.note: The default could not be verified. Opt-in subagent_spawn is documented: 'The coordinator spawns subagents via the `task` tool' (docs/adding-an-agent.md).

human_in_loop.note: Harness start_turn takes approval_mode, and Hermes supports 'approvals'. The README says agents notify the human when they need input. The default policy is unknown.

long_term_memory.note: Hermes (a wrapped agent) keeps memory. The CAR-level memory store could not be checked without source.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The agent supports durable thread/session operations: create, resume, and execute turns

self_verification.note: Review workloads exist via start_review, but it is unclear whether CAR enforces them; no source available.

termination_condition.note: The loop ends when no incomplete tickets remain (README), but the condition code was not available.

cost_controls.note: Configurable subagent models for review are a possible form of routing, but this is not verified.

timeouts.note: The supervisor example has request_timeout, but this is a doc template, not the shipped config.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Supervisor**: Manages agent process lifecycle (for agents that run as subprocesses)
execution_isolation.note: The README targets running on your own machine. A Docker runtime per repo/worktree is an optional add-on.

filesystem_access.note: sandbox_policy is passed through to agents; its default is unknown.

tracing.note: A run history contract (docs/RUN_HISTORY.md) is referenced but was not included.

target_domain.evidence_quote: CAR is a meta-harness for coding agents (Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, anything ACP).

open_source.note: No LICENSE in bundle; the project is distributed on PyPI.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: CAR is a meta-harness for coding agents (Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, anything ACP).
model_agnostic.note: Agent-agnostic; model choice happens via the wrapped agents' model_catalog.

primary_artifact.note: The bundle also contains an unrelated ACL 2026 paper/repo named CAR (Create And Replan); it was ignored.

stars.note: No star count for Git-on-my-level/codex-autorunner. The 'stars: 0' in the bundle belongs to the unrelated Lancetwang/car repo.
